verification_level: FAST plus BATCH. Eight files audited; one low-severity compatibility defect repaired with a focused regression test, one documentation correction, no memory-safety defect, no ABI/layout regression, no new unsafe operation and no new hidden obligation. No affected C probe transcript changes (see gates_observed.affected_probe).
scope: Per-file contract audit of the head entries of REMAINING-AUDIT.txt: the X509_CRL/X509_REVOKED accessor and mutator layer; the nine X509_STORE load/default-path drivers; the 27 extension accessors over X509/X509_CRL/X509_REVOKED and the static delete_ext helper; the X509_LOOKUP_METHOD constructor/destructor and vtable; X509_NAME_oneline and its BUF_MEM ownership; X509_REQ_to_X509; the three X509_REQ setters; and the Netscape SPKI convenience surface.

defects.detail: X509_CRL_set1_nextUpdate rejected a NULL `tm` with 0 (`if x.is_null() || tm.is_null()`). The exact authority tag openssl-3.6.4/crypto/x509/x509cset.c:50-55 refuses only a NULL `x`; a NULL `tm` reaches ossl_x509_set1_time, which frees the previous time, writes NULL, marks enc.modified and answers 1. The old code left the previous nextUpdate in place and answered 0, so X509_CRL_diff (src/x509/x509_vfy.rs:1416) raised X509_VFY_2463 where the authority succeeds. Repaired by removing the extra NULL test and widening the declared contract to `tm` NULL-or-live; a focused regression test now pins the clear-and-answer-1 behaviour and the sibling setters' NULL rejection. The line number is the pre-edit locus; the function now begins at line 134.

documentation_corrections: src/x509/x509cset.rs:126-132: X509_CRL_set1_nextUpdate's doc now states that, unlike _set1_lastUpdate and X509_REVOKED_set_revocationDate, the authority rejects only a NULL object and routes a NULL time to ossl_x509_set1_time's clear case; the # Safety contract widened from non-NULL `tm` to NULL-or-live.

src/x509/x509_obj.rs:30-31: the module note named only X509_OBJ_75 and X509_OBJ_175; the second NAME_TOO_LONG coordinate actually used by the printer is X509_OBJ_116, and the note now names all three generated sites.
boundary_control: No negative control was added: the batch found no memory-safety defect. The repaired branch is a compatibility relation, and its control is a differential read of the exact authority tag (openssl-3.6.4/crypto/x509/x509cset.c) plus a focused unit test (`x509::x509cset::tests::next_update_clears_on_null_like_the_authority`) that observes the clear, the 1 answer, and the sibling setters' retained 0 answer.

RT-STORE (`courts/phase10/rt_store_probe.c:1643`) calls X509_CRL_set1_nextUpdate with a non-NULL tm, so its transcript is unchanged by the corrected NULL path; it was therefore not re-run and is recorded as NOT_RUN for this sweep rather than claimed as a pass.

retained_obligations: src/x509/x509cset.rs: every getter borrows a field of a live CRL/REVOKED. X509_CRL_set_version allocates the version integer only when absent and leaves a failed set unmodified; X509_CRL_set_issuer_name relies on X509_NAME_set's NULL-rejection and duplicate-or-identity contract; _set1_lastUpdate and X509_REVOKED_set_revocationDate reject NULL time per the authority, while _set1_nextUpdate accepts NULL and clears; X509_CRL_sort relies on the revoked stack's already-installed comparator (the authority sets it at item construction) and renumbers only live elements; X509_REVOKED_set_serialNumber relies on ASN1_STRING_copy's NULL rejection and identity shortcut.

src/x509/x509_d2.rs: ctx is a live X509_STORE; file/path/uri are NULL-or-NUL-terminated; libctx is NULL-or-live and propq NULL-or-NUL-terminated; the three method constructors answer static tables' addresses; a failed add_lookup answers 0 and the ctrl commands' own answers are ignored or tested exactly as the macros do.

src/x509/x509_ext.rs: each carrier is live so its extension field is a writable slot; X509v3_* accepts NULL-or-live stacks; the static delete_ext removes through X509v3_delete_ext and, whenever the slot is non-NULL and now empty, releases it with OPENSSL_sk_pop_free and writes NULL, matching x509_ext.c's unconditional empty-list arm; X509V3_get_d2i/add1_i2d receive NULL-or-writable crit/idx and the nid method's expected value type; the free_x509_extension thunk accepts NULL or a crate-allocated extension.

src/x509/x509_meth.rs: CRYPTO_zalloc's block is zeroed and therefore a valid method from its first byte; RawMethod releases only the block on the constructor's error path, OwnedMethod releases name then block on free; from_raw requires a block this file allocated through the seam that no other owner will release and a name that is NULL or this file's strdup block; each vtable setter stores the application callback without invoking it and each getter borrows it.

src/x509/x509_obj.rs: a is NULL-or-live; buf is either NULL (the printer allocates and transfers the grown data block) or writable for len bytes; entries, entry objects and values are live for a live name; the BUF_MEM handle transfers only the data block at the two result sites and runs the full destructor on every error path; the three raise coordinates are BUF_LIB at 175 and NAME_TOO_LONG at 75 and 116.

src/x509/x509_r2x.rs: r is a live X509_REQ and pkey a live MD5-capable private key; every failed construction arm frees the half-built certificate exactly once; the request's attributes never become the certificate's extensions (the authority's commented-out assignment is not done); OPENSSL_sk_num(NULL) is -1, matching the authority's attribute test.

src/x509/x509rset.rs: x is NULL-or-live and name/pkey are NULL-or-live; the version setter raises ERR_LIB_X509/ERR_R_PASSED_INVALID_ARGUMENT at the authority's coordinate for a NULL request or a non-v1 version and otherwise delegates to ASN1_INTEGER_set on the request's own version pointer; the name/key setters mark the cached encoding stale before delegating to X509_NAME_set/X509_PUBKEY_set.

src/x509/x509spki.rs: x/spki are live or NULL; str is NUL-terminated and readable for len bytes when len > 0; both base64 scratch blocks are OwnedBuf-owned at the authority's file seam and released on every exit; the encoder allocates the exact 4*ceil(n/3)+1 extent, the documented §17 correction of the authority's under-sized 2*n block; d2i/i2d follow the ASN.1 cursor contract.
residuals: M88-R1 (info, authority behaviour preserved): NETSCAPE_SPKI_b64_encode allocates the encoder's exact output extent instead of the authority's 2*der_len, which under-sizes for der_len = 1, 2 and 4. This is the documented §17 correction already recorded in x509spki.rs; the returned string's observable content is unchanged and no memory-safety obligation is introduced.
secret_bearing_buffers: No secret-bearing buffer or cleansing claim changed. These units handle public certificate, CRL, request, extension and lookup-method data; the base64, BUF_MEM and method-name blocks are public buffers released through their owners. No CRYPTO_clear_free arm exists or was removed here.
